newsitem.title: UK: Tom Cobleigh in talks for possible sale.
newsitem.headline: Tom Cobleigh in talks for possible sale.

text.p: Pub operator Tom Cobleigh Plc said it is in talks with an unnamed party for a possible sale of the company.

"The board of Tom Cobleigh announces that it is in discussions which may or may not lead to an offer being received for the whole of the issued share capital of the company," the company said in a statement. "A further announcement will be made when appropriate."

Tom Cobleigh, a pub retailer operating in Yorkshire and the Midlands, in August had said it was cooperating with Earlier European Acquisition Capital Ltd (EAC) in examining options for disposing of EAC's 50 percent stake in the company.
Tom Cobleigh's shares were up 19 pence at 231.5p following Friday's announcement.
